blocks.text: Probability = kisi waqiye (event) ke hone ki tadaad ÷ kul mumkina nataij (total possible outcomes).

blocks.title: Performing and Recoding (kar ke dekhein)
blocks.text: Dice 100 baar phenkein aur probability ke qaide se andaza lagayein ke kitni baar chhakka (six) aayega. Har phenk par chhakke ki probability 1/6 hai, pichhle nataij chahe kuch bhi hon. To 100 baar mein taqreeban 100 × 1/6, yaani lag bhag 17 chhakke aane chahiyen. Apni ginti likh kar is andaze se milayein.
Misaal: agar 7,324 matar ke beejon mein 1,850 jhurridar hon to probability 1,850 ÷ 7,324 = 0.253 hai, yaani taqreeban har 4 beejon mein se 1.
